claim.why_it_matters: The heading is invisible to the outline and to any tool that locates clauses by heading, so citations to §1985:IX.1.3.x cannot be resolved to this text by structure.
claim.detail: Numbered subsection heading demoted to a plain paragraph line (no heading marker).

verdict.reasoning: The printed page 472 (folio IX-2, Indexed I-O - Introduction) shows '1.3.3 File Position Indicator' set as a numbered subsection heading on its own line, like 1.3.2 and 1.3.4. In specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md line 18460 it is a bare paragraph line with no '#' marker, while the parallel Relative I-O heading (line 17190) is '### 1.3.3 File Position Indicator'. The text is identical, so this is structural only: the heading is missing from the outline. The same page also leaves 1.3.2 (line 18452) and 1.3.4 (line 18464) unmarked, but those are separate claims.
